role: Appendix-only side analysis; do not alter or pool with the primary text-only results.
model_scope: Only current-generation multimodal checkpoints in the historical archive; Gemma 3 conditions are excluded.

inference.fisher_site_selection: Recompute the full PCA-space Fisher profile and reselect the maximum under every task-label assignment.
inference.probe_site_selection: Use the assignment-specific unadjusted Fisher maximum, then refit the held-out-task probe.

conditions.surface_modality: Fold-local Ridge adjustment for six text-surface variables, task-level visual-input presence, and three response-format indicators.
conditions.lexical_64: Fold-local character-within-word TF-IDF, 64-component truncated SVD, and activation Ridge adjustment.
conditions.combined_64: The surface/modality and 64-component lexical nuisance columns concatenated inside each training-task fold.

claim_limit: This panel deliberately mixes modality, domain, response format, and benchmark family. Text-channel and task-level modality controls do not represent image content. Results describe separability of these ten named tasks only and cannot validate a general knowledge-reasoning construct.
main_text_policy: Do not change the primary tables, abstract, or main-text conclusions from this appendix-only analysis.
